description: §52.13.1 / §52.13.2 (S449 ruling item 4) — `<page auth="role:admin">` is E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID (was W-ATTR-002): role-based access is not an `auth=` value; the page would otherwise declare nothing.
rationale: §52.13.1 as amended S449: on `<program>` / `<page>` the `role:X` shape is E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID. Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 "RULED — 'your recs.'" item 4 — 'Unrecognized / non-literal `auth=` (incl. `""`) = (a): compile error; amend §52.13.2 (supersedes its W-ATTR-002 + "no auth gate" SHALL).'
